title: Amplification
summary: AMPLIFICA'TION, noun [Latin amplificatio.] 1. Enlargement; extension. 2. In rhetoric, diffusive description or discussion; exaggerated representation; copious argument, intended to present the subject

inlines.v: AMPLIFICA'TION, noun [Latin amplificatio.] 1. Enlargement; extension. 2. In rhetoric, diffusive description or discussion; exaggerated representation; copious argument, intended to present the subject in every view or in the strongest light; diffuse narrative, or a dilating upon all the particulars of a subject; a description given in more words than are necessary, or an illustration by various examples and proofs.
